result.summary: Finalizes the 32.0 release by bumping the client version to v32.0, regenerating manual pages, and reintegrating the draft release notes into the repository.
result.problem: Before a major release can be tagged and distributed, the version numbers in build files must reflect the final release rather than a pre-release development tag, manpages must be synchronized with the latest binary options, and accumulated release documentation must be brought into tree.
evidence: PR description: 'Bump version to `v32.0`. Regenerate manpages. Reintegrate release notes: https://github.com/bitcoin-core/bitcoin-devwiki/wiki/32.0-Release-Notes-Draft.'
Commit 4c9d491351 sets CLIENT_VERSION_IS_RELEASE to 'true' and CLIENT_VERSION_MINOR to 0 in CMakeLists.txt.
result.scope_notes: The 3 commits in this PR only touch 9 files (CMakeLists.txt, man pages, and release-notes.md), but the merge-base diff against the target branch includes earlier backport commits.
result.changed_since_previous: Diff and commit history are now available; the PR commits are confirmed to be strictly the version bump, manpage regeneration, and release notes reintegration.
result.card: Prepares the 32.0 release branch for final tagging. It bumps the project version to v32.0, sets release status to true, updates manual pages, and merges the compiled release notes into the repository. This is the routine maintenance PR required to finalize and cut the v32.0 release.

risk.why: A mistake in the release version flags or build configuration would produce improperly tagged release binaries distributed to end users.
